Description:
With a resounding impact, the greatsword cleaves through the air, connecting with the beast's tail in a mighty blow. The wyvern wheels around, its massive jaws primed to ensnare the warrior in their deadly embrace. In a daring maneuver, the fighter relinquishes her blade, seizing the wyvern's jaw in a vice-like grip, diverting its momentum towards a nearby tree. She ascends onto the creature's head, plunging her blade deep into its eye with lethal precision. It is then that you observe a miraculous sight: her previously bloody wounds have miraculously sealed, as if cauterized by the scorching heat of battle and the coursing adrenaline of combat.
Warriors are talented in using any type of weapon, with hand-to-hand combat capabilities way beyond the average adventurer. Brawn and tactics are a warrior's aces in the sleeve.
A warrior is a physical combatant, but that does not stop them from overcoming challenges. With mastery over arms, body or range, a warrior may improvise and lead their way to victory.
Quick Note: A warrior is a physical combatant, but that does not stop them from overcoming challenges. With mastery over arms, body or range, a warrior may improvise and lead their way to victory.
Proficiency Requirements: You have Skilled in Athletics, Acrobatics and have a number of extra non-combat Skills equal to your Intelligence or Presence, whichever is higher.

~Skilled in Athletics~.Effect: Add your Level to all Might Checks for using your physical strength (e.g. lifting, breaking by hand, etc).

~Skilled in Acrobatics~.Effect: Add your Level to all Dexterity Checks for jumping, climbing, fitting through gaps, maintaining balance and other acrobatic moves.

Proficiencies Description: Your physical training as a Warrior provides you with enough practice and muscle memory to be able to succeed at the more difficult hand-to-hand tasks, such as swimming, lifting and jumping.
Weapons: You are Trained in all weapons, including Shields.

Spellcasting.Spell Grade: 6 + Intelligence, Presence or Presence, whichever is higher

Mana.Regain: You regain all Mana back inbetween Adventures.

Spellcasting.Change: You can change your known Spells and Talents inbetween Adventures.
Spellcasting.Other: All Warrior-specific Abilities are not considered Spells (unless stated otherwise).
Spellcasting.Recommended Abilities Description: Warriors should be able to withhold damage, and as such, we recommend Recuperate for some extra healing and breaking enemy effects on you. Slam will provide you with area damage and Chilling Shout is a great ranged attack for the Mana cost. If you still have more available Basic Spells, no-one ever complained about having Bull Rush - it's a great passive effect for dealing extra damage. Lastly, if your Presence is low, Atonement will be great in combat for survival, if you're expecting to take a lot of damage.

~Charge~.Effect: Freely dash exactly 2 meters toward a Worthy Enemy, landing on the closest space, near them.

~War Craft~.Effect:
No two warriors fight alike. Choose your War Craft from below!
Each War Craft usually gives you a way to deal {Color('#ff5900' '+1d4 extra Damage each Turn')}.
~War Craft~.Upgrade: You may change your War Craft inbetween Adventures.

Other Abilities Description: Choose one of the following War Crafts that will change your playstyle! These are not the same as the Level 1 Talents (which are below), and you still get one free War Craft and one free Level 1 Talent.

~Shield Craft~.Effect: Use after you are melee attacked. Deal 1d4 Smash Damage with your {Color('#ff5900' 'shield')} to the attacker.

~Dualwield Craft~.Effect: Your {Color('#ff5900' 'second one-handed')} attack with a real weapon each Turn deals +1d4 Damage {Color('#ff5900' 'if it is with a different weapon than the first attack')}.

~Heavy Weapon Craft~.Effect: Your first {Color('#ff5900' 'two-handed')} weapon attack each Turn deals +1d4 Damage {Color('#ff5900' 'if there is an Ally, obstacle or wall directly behind the target')}.

~Throw Craft~.Effect:
You may throw real melee weapons with a 3-5 meter range. They deal -1 Damage for one-handed weapons (or -2 Damage for two-handed weapons).
Your first {Color('#ff5900' 'thrown')} weapon attack each Turn deals +1d4 Damage {Color('#ff5900' 'if it's the first Act you do on your Turn and you have a clear throw to the target')}.

~Unarmed Craft~.Effect: Your {Color('#ff5900' 'second Punch')} attack each Turn deals +1d4 Damage {Color('#ff5900' "if it's on a different target than the first")}.

~Marksman Craft~.Effect:
Your first ~ranged~ weapon attack each Turn deals +1d4 Damage {Color('#ff5900' 'if there is no Unit or obstacle near the target')}.
Your Charge becomes Uncharge.

~Uncharge~.Effect: Freely dash exactly 2 meters toward an ~Ally~, landing on the closest space, near them.
~Uncharge~.Combo: If the Ally had a Combo, make a free Movement Action.

~Dual Shield Craft~.Effect:
You can Dual Wield shields and attack with them for 1d6 + ^Any Stat^ Damage.
After you Charge, gain 1d4 Shielding.

~Improvisation Craft~.Effect: Your first {Color('#ff5900' 'Improvised Attack')} each Turn deals +1d6 Damage {Color('#ff5900' 'if it's with an improvised weapon type you haven't used this Adventure')}.

~Old-Fashioned Craft~.Effect: Your first {Color('#ff5900' 'old-fashioned')} weapon attack each Turn deals extra Damage equal to ^Any Stat^, {Color('#ff5900' 'and applies a Combo if the target is a Person')}.
~Old-Fashioned Craft~.Upgrade: Old-fashioned weapons are weapons that do not deal extra Damage with any Stat (e.g. Hammer).

~Command - March~.Effect: Choose a direction. All Allies (including you) may move up to 3 meters in that direction.

~Break Mountains~.Effect: Pick up an object up to 2x2x2 meters in size, and Slam it 3d10 meters in any direction.
~Break Mountains~.EffectGreen: Critical Strike - for each max die rolled, deal +1d6 Damage and the object breaks on impact!

~Whirlwind~.Upgrade: The Ability is Whirlwind if a melee weapon is equipped, or Rain Death if a ranged weapon is equipped.
~Whirlwind~.Notes:
Each rolled die ^must^ be assigned to a Unit.
The Damage type depends on the weapon currently equipped. Doesn't apply weapon effects (the weapon only matters for the Damage type).

Variants.Name: Rain Death
Variants.Area: in a chosen 4x4 meter area (5 meter range to the edge).

~Takeback~.Effect: Deal 1d4 Damage to a Unit and Single-Stun it. Then end your Turn.

~Vault Break~.Effect:
Slam the ground so hard that it shatters one obstacle that fits within a 3x3x3 meter area.
After casting this Ability, if you moved this turn, you can continue your movement.
~Vault Break~.Notes: It is the Quest Master's call if an obstacle can be broken. Most walls can't be broken, except for thinner ones and fences.

~Sound Mind~.Effect: Block any non-damaging negative incoming _effect_ on an ally you can see.
~Sound Mind~.Upgrade: Negative effects in this case means any Crowd Control, Debuff, Curse, mind-altering magic, non-Damaging Poison, etc.

~Doublesault~.Effect: Leap up to 3 meters. If you land on a Unit, Doublesault again (for free)!
~Doublesault~.Notes:
You leap from Unit to Unit until you no longer land on a Unit. If you land on a Unit, you must leap again. You can't leap on the same Unit twice; if you do, you end your leap in the closest space near it.
You can use this even while in the air and it cancels out your current fall or acceleration.

~Snap Out Of It~.Effect: Attack a different Unit with a 1-handed weapon. It heals instead of dealing Damage.
~Snap Out Of It~.Notes: Any extra Damage effects on it heal as well (e.g. Smite, Cursewielder, etc).

Starting Abilities Description.Advanced Flank:
Warriors are great at using their teammates and the terrain to make flanking attacks!
When an enemy is caught directly between you and another ally of yours, that attack counts as a Flank Attack, and it deals +1 Damage (normally). Your Advanced Flank transforms the +1 into 1d6 Damage to the first Flank Attack you make every turn!
This works now if there is a wall or an obstacle directly behind your target, so use the environment to your advantage!
Note that this only works for melee attacks and on enemies 1 meter away from you (e.g. enemies directly in front of you).

Specializations.Description: At Level 1, you can choose your specialization. Every Warrior can choose from the following Warrior specializations
Choices: Fighter, a person specialized in weapon fighting and body-to-body combat
Battlemaster, a heavily trained and armed warrior; master yourself - master the enemy
Barbarian, a crude and battle thirsty warrior, who seeks to shed blood and lives for the fight
Marksman, a precise and mechanical soldier, always finding the best tactic and position; the Marksman wins the battle before it begins

~Strength and Honor~.Effect:
You may exceed the Level limits for maximum Stats.
You start with +1 in any Stat.
~Strength and Honor~.Notes: The maximum a Stat can be until Level 4 is +3. Between 4 and 8 is +4. There is no limit from Level 8 on.

~Bristleback~.Effect: You take less Damage when struck from behind. Enemies with 2 or less Presence...

~Hemmingstep~.Effect: When standing right next to a wall, you take -1 Damage from all sources.

~Painfeast~.Effect: Until the start of your next Turn, all Damage you take is transformed into Healing instead!

~Heavenbreaker~.Effect:
You jump high up above the battlefield and end your Turn.
At the start of your next Turn, you plunge into the earth like a comet toward a destintion space.
All Units within 3 meters of you take X Damage TODO and a crater forms in the zone, 2 meters deep at the extremities of the area.

<Quick Maneuvers>.Effect: Immediately after you make a weapon attack, choose one effect to apply.
<Quick Maneuvers>.Notes: Taunted means its next offensive Act has Cover if it's not on you.

~Third Wind~.Effect: Take 1d10 Damage. Gain +1 Action this Turn.

~Command - Patience~.Effect: A Unit you can see gains a number of 1d8 Shieldings equal to the Round Number.

<Opportunity Attacks>.Effect: When an enemy exits your melee attack range, make a free attack on them with a one-handed melee weapon.
<Opportunity Attacks>.Notes: If you don't have the weapon equipped, you automatically freely equip it, attack with it, unequip it and equip what you previously had.

<MIGHT OVER MAGIC>.Effect:
When you get this, choose a Minor Talent from (any Specialization of) Cleric, Mage or Warlock, up to your Level.
That Ability becomes a ^physical version of itself^: instead of using magic to cast that spell, you use your body/weapons/tools!
<MIGHT OVER MAGIC>.Upgrade: The Damage of that Spell becomes Slash, Smash or Pierce, whichever makes sense.
<MIGHT OVER MAGIC>.Notes:
E.g. Scorching Rays - you shoot 3 arrows with your bow (Pierce Damage). Be creative, come up with a description of how it works!
You can change this Ability inbetween Adventures.

<Glory Run>.Effect:
When Worthy Combat starts, a Glory Point appears directly behind the furthermost Enemy from you.
The first time you reach the Glory Point, heal for 1d10.
<Glory Run>.Notes: The Glory Point is just a space/zone.

<Overthrow>.Effect: When you Slam a Unit into a Wall, it becomes Single-Stunned.

~Lead Commander~.Effect: Whenever you use a Command Ability, heal yourself or an affected Unit by 1d6.

~Command - Focus Fire~.Effect: Choose a target. Command all Allies (except you) in your party to make a Half-Action Act on the chosen target.
~Command - Focus Fire~.Upgrade: Can affect up to 5 Allies. If there are only 2 or less Allies, you also make the Half-Action.

~Deathblow~.Effect:
If your last 2 offensive Acts both either triggered a Critical Strike or a Combo, your next single target {Type} deals +{Amount}% Damage.
~Click on the Icon to select a preferred effect!~
~Deathblow~.Notes: This is not considered a Critical Strike. The extra Damage includes bonuses from War Craft and similar Abilities.

~Critical Strike~.Effect: Your next weapon attack triggers its Critical Strike and Combo effect anyway!
~Critical Strike~.Notes: Has no effect on weapons without such an effect.

~Hack and Slash~.Effect:
Your next {Effect}
~Click on the Icon to select a preferred effect!~
~Hack and Slash~.Notes:
Roll the attack only once.
Weapon effects (like Critical Strikes), if necessary, are applied to the main target only.

Variants.Name: Hack and Slash
Variants.Effect: melee 2-handed weapon attack also hits all other Units 1 meter from you, but deals -50% Damage to them (deals normal Damage to the main target).

Variants.Name: Slice and Dice
Variants.Effect: melee 1-handed weapon attack also hits all other Units 1 meter from you.

Variants.Name: Lock and Load
Variants.Effect: ranged 2-handed weapon attack also hits all other Units 1 meter from the main target, but deals -50% Damage to them (deals normal Damage to the main target).

Variants.Name: Point and Shoot
Variants.Effect: ranged 1-handed weapon attack also hits all other Units 1 meter from the main target.

~Bull Rush~.Effect: If you move at least 3 meters in a straight line and then melee Attack a target on the same line, the Attack gains +1 for every 3 meters moved in the straight line.
~Bull Rush~.Notes: Works if mounted or if using Abilities that dash or jump (in a straight line), but teleporting interrupts this.

~Fame and Fortune~.Effect:
The next time you deal Damage, gain {Gold}Gold equal to 300% of the Damage dealt.

You also get Goldborn.

~Goldborn~.Effect: You can spend 300 {Gold}Gold to gain +2 Maximum Health, up to +10 total.

~Overunder Blow~.Effect:
Instead of dealing extra Damage with Deathblow, do one of the following.

Also, passively, you have +1 Intelligence (up to your Level limit).
SingleTable: 2. Single-Stun the target (Double-Stun for two-handed weapons)

~Weaponmaster~.Effect: If your {Type} weapon can't Critical Strike, it gains the following effect.
~Weaponmaster~.EffectGreen: Critical Strike - if you rolled maximum on at least one die, deal {Amount} Damage.

<MIGHT OVER MAGIC>.Effect:
Choose a Minor Talent from (any Specialization of) Cleric, Mage or Warlock, up to your Level.
You can use it Once / Adventure, without spending Mana.
That Ability becomes a ^physical version of itself^: instead of using magic to cast that spell, you use your body/weapons/tools!
<MIGHT OVER MAGIC>.Upgrade:
The Damage of that spell becomes Slash, Smash or Pierce, whichever makes sense.
Come up with a description of how it works! You can change this Ability inbetween Advetures.
<MIGHT OVER MAGIC>.Notes:
E.g. Scorching Rays - you shoot 3 arrows with your bow (Pierce Damage).
E.g. Frost Nova - you smash the ground with such force that it Damages and Slows units around you (Smash Damage).
Be creative!

~Off-Hand Shank~.Effect: Make 3 attacks with a one-handed weapon you haven't used this turn that would normally scale with a Stat. These attacks do not add your Stat to the Damage.

~Tug of War~.Effect: After you move from place, your next attack deals +1 Damage and is considered a Critical Strike.

~Critical War Craft~.Effect: Bonus Damage dealt by your War Craft is considered Critical Strike.

<Into the Fray>.Effect:
When combat starts, determine which side is your Allied Side and which is the Enemy Side of the battlefield. Each side has a direction (Allied Direction and Enemy Direction).
If you end your turn more to the Allied Direction than you started, you gain 4 Shielding until the start of your next turn.
If you end your turn more to the Enemy Direction than you started, your first attack next turn deals 1d6 extra Damage.

<Glory Run>.Effect:
When combat starts, a Glory Point appears behind the furthermost Enemy from you that you can see.
If you touch the Glory Point, heal for 20% of your total Health and all Enemies you can see must become Single-Stunned.
The Glory Point then disappears.
<Glory Run>.Notes: The Glory Point is not a physical thing. It's merely a concept (a point).

<Ruining Throw>.Effect:
TODO: MAKE THIS COOLER BRUV
ALSO it has an upgrade that makes it return.
Throw a weapon at a target and attack it (without Throwing penalties and ignoring Cover).
Before applying the Damage, the attack destroys all Shielding and Defense on the target and removes all buffs on it.
The target can't trigger "on roll", can't gain Shielding and can't benefit from Buffs until they spend an Action to recover.
<Ruining Throw>.Upgrade: Epic Monsters gain ther Defense back when they spend the Action to recover.
<Ruining Throw>.Notes:
Your weapon lands at the nearest space to the target (and you should probably pick it up with a Half-Action).
"On roll" refers to effects like "if it rolls 10 on a d10, the attack deals 1d10 extra Damage".
Buffs are all effects that improve the target; even passive effects like auras or passive stats from abilities are negated.
You don't need Training in Throwning and this attack counts as a regular melee attack.

~Breathing Technique~.Effect: You can breathe underwater for up to 1d20 minutes and swim at your normal speed.

~Renown~.Effect: Due to your deeds and radiating confidence, have an extra 10% discount on buying anything.

<Personal Squire>.Effect:
You recruit a squire - a trusted NPC who gains combat powers. However, the capabilities of your squire are random: roll 1d6 to determine the type of your squire, based on the Squires category at Pets and Animals (1. Bold, 2. Sneaky, 3. Clever, 4. Wise). The Race is determined by the QM or by circumstance.
On its turn, it can do one Pet Attack, cast one Ability it has, or do the equivalent of a Half-Action (e.g. Dash, Push, etc).
You can recruit one squire per Adventure, but only one can follow you in your adventures at a time.
At the start of every Adventure (and when you get this Talent), you must spend 1 Mana and train your Squire to permanently increase its Health by 2 or gain one Ability from any other Squire type.
<Personal Squire>.Upgrade: If your squire drops to 0 Health, it becomes Fallen, like a player. It has no Health Regen, but at any point outside of combat, you (the pet owner) can spend 30 minutes to tend to your squire's wounds and heal it back to full Health.
<Personal Squire>.Notes: Your squire is not a Player Character by any means and does not behave like one (it can't use Weapons, Armor, Feats, Abilities, etc like a Player Character can). It is limited to what its stat block and Abilities say it can do. You can, however, give it orders, customize its looks (hair style, clothes, etc) and it will obey your commands within reason. You are the leader it looks up to. Lead proudly and fairly!

<Attack Command>.Effect:
An ally immediately makes an Act that takes 1 Action (can spend Mana, Cooldowns, etc on it, as if it were on its turn).
You can use this at any point, before or after someone does an Act.
^You^ roll all the dice for this Act.

<MIGHT OVER MAAAGIC!!!>.Effect:
Choose ^TWO^ Basic Abilities from the Elemental, Nature or Eldritch Schools that cost 1 Mana.
You can use each of those Abilities once per Adventure (without spending Mana).
See the Level 5 Talent _Might Over Magic_.

<Perfect Strike>.Effect:
Your next weapon attack this turn deals +300% Damage. If it kills the target, overkill Damage is dealt to all enemies within 3 meters of the main target.
Also, passively, you gain +2 Dexterity and you are immune to monster _weapon effects_ (e.g. critical strikes).

<Master Tactician>.Effect:
Gain +4 Max Health and +1 Damage on all attacks for every 3 sessions the Campaign has progressed.
From now on, at the end of every session, gain +4 Max Health and +1 Damage on all attacks.
Also, passively, gain +2 Intelligence and you know the Abilities and strategies of all enemies you encounter.

<Greatwielder>.Effect:
You can wield 2-Handed weapons, one in each hand.
Attacks like this take only a Half-Action and count as 1-Handed weapon attacks but deal -2 Damage.
While dual wielding 2-Handed weapons, if any Ability tells you to perform an attack with a 2-Handed and the ability costs 1 Action, it costs only Half-Action.
Also, passively, gain +1 Might and +1 Dexterity.
<Greatwielder>.Notes: If you already have a Technique Feat, you can remove it to refund the cost.

~Onslaught~.Effect: Whenever ^YOU^ kill a Worthy Enemy, heal for 1d6 Health. In addition, if an Enemy has 25% or less Health, you know exactly how much Health it has (ask the QM).

~Reckless Charge~.Effect:
Freely dash exactly 2 meters towards a Worthy Enemy, landing on the closest space. It becomes Rooted.
~Your next weapon attack deals 2d6 extra Damage to the target and half of that to yourself.~
You can only use this once on every Worthy Enemy.

<Hack and Slash>.Effect:
Your next {Effect}
~Click on the Icon to select a preferred effect!~
<Hack and Slash>.Notes:
Roll the attack only once.
Weapon effects (like Critical Strikes), if necessary, are applied to the main target only.

Variants.Name: Hack and Slash
Variants.Effect: melee 2-handed weapon attack also hits all other Units 1 meter from you, but deals -50% Damage to them (deals normal Damage to the main target).

Variants.Name: Slice and Dice
Variants.Effect: melee 1-handed weapon attack also hits all other Units 1 meter from you.

Variants.Name: Lock and Load
Variants.Effect: ranged 2-handed weapon attack also hits all other Units 1 meter from the main target, but deals -50% Damage to them (deals normal Damage to the main target).

Variants.Name: Point and Shoot
Variants.Effect: ranged 1-handed weapon attack also hits all other Units 1 meter from the main target.

<Undying Rage>.Effect:
Taking Damage that would kill you puts you in a state of primal rage, and leaves you at 1 Health instead.
For the rest of the Combat, increase all Healing you do on yourself by 50%.

<Blood and Fire>.Effect:
Take 1d6 Damage.
Strike a Unit for an amount of Fire Damage equal to 50% of your missing Health.

<Heartbeat Trance>.Effect:
Take 1d6 Damage.
Then, until the ^end^ of your next Turn, you take 50% less Damage (including from your own Abilities).
When Heartbeat Trance ends, heal for 1d6.

<Rage Trance>.Effect:
Take 1d6 Damage.
Until the ^end^ of your next Turn, all your attacks deal +1d4 Damage and Onslaught healing is increased by 100%.
When Rage Trance ends, heal for 1d6.

<Battle Trance>.Effect:
Take 1d6 Damage.
Until the ^end^ of your next Turn, all Damage you do to yourself becomes Healing instead and you are immune to Crowd Control.
When Battle Trance ends, heal for 2d6.

<Hunger For Blood>.Effect: Whenever you deal Damage to a Worthy Enemy, heal for 10% of it (rounded down).

<Last Resort>.Effect:
Take 1d6 Damage.
Your next single-target weapon attack deals +1d20 Damage.
For the rest of the Combat, you deal -50% Damage but increase all Healing you do by 50%.

~FURY~.Upgrade: Every time you do Healing or weapon Damage, do +1 for each {Orange('Fury')}, then lose 1 {Orange('Fury')}.

~Painful Puncture~.Effect: Attack a Unit for 1d6 + 2 Damage of your ^weapon^'s type. Its Passives, weapon* effects and Reactions are disabled until the start of your next Turn.
~Painful Puncture~.Notes: Its Passives become disabled before you hit it (e.g. Kobolds don't dodge this attack). Some monsters have special weapon* effects, like Centaurs who gain extra Damage based on how much they moved. These are disabled.

<Blood Craft>.Effect: Whenever you Damage with War Craft to a Worthy Enemy, Damage yourself equal to the original roll, then increase it by 100% to the enemy.

<Death Mark>.Effect:
Mark a Unit you can see for death.
Whenever YOU deal Damage to it until your next turn, remember the Damage done.
At the start of your next turn, the mark bursts and the Unit takes 50% of the Damage it has taken in this time period.

<One With My Body>.Effect: Choose any Druid or Hunter Utility Talent from any Level.

<Victory Strike>.Effect:
Attack a Unit for 2d10 Damage of your weapon's type.
Whenever ^YOU^ kill a Worthy Enemy (with anything), reset the Cooldown of this Ability.

<Frenzy>.Effect:
If you start your turn with 25 or less Health, you have +1 Movement Speed and can Break your Movement.
if you start with 15 or less Health, you also have an extra Half-Action.

<Hurl Over>.Effect:
Grab another non-Epic Unit and throw them up to 10 meters away.
Upon landing, all other Units within 3 meters of the landing place take 3d8 Pulse Damage.
If it was an Enemy, the Thrown Unit takes 50% of the Damage.

<Bloodbath>.Effect: You heal for all Damage done by Advanced Flank on Worthy Enemies.

<Flesh of Iron>.Effect:
You Heal for all Damage you would deal to yourself instead of taking it. Pierce, Slash and Smash attacks can't Damage you below 1 Health (they leave you to 1 Health).
Also, passively, you gain +2 Might.

<Ferocity Unleashed>.Effect:
If you start your turn with 50% or less Health, you have an extra 1 Action on your turn.
Also, passively, gain +1 Might, Dexterity and Presence, you are immune to exhaustion in Worthy Combat and you can survive without sleep for 7 days.
<Ferocity Unleashed>.Notes: This stacks with the Frenzy Talent.

<MIGHT BRAWN MUSCLE>.Effect: GAIN +10 MIGHT AND THE RESULTS OF ALL YOUR MIGHT CHECKS ARE DOUBLED.

~Uncharge~.Effect:
Freely dash 2 meters ~away from~ a Worthy Enemy. ~Its first attack on its next Turn deals -2 Damage.
You can only use this once on every Worthy Enemy.

~Marksmanship~.Effect: YOU can Flank a Unit from any range (if you, the target, and the ally, wall or obstacle are on the same line).
~Marksmanship~.Notes: As usual, that ally, wall or obstacle helping with your Flank must be right behind the target (meaning allies can't Flank an enemy with you being far away).

~Load Up~.Effect:
You _load up_ your weapons. After you _load up_, your Advanced Flank die becomes 1d12 instead of 1d6, but every time you use it, the Advanced Flank die becomes ^Downgraded^ (down to 1d4).
If the attack kills the target, don't Downgrade.

<Recoiling Uncharge>.Effect:
Freely dash up to 2 meters away from a Worthy Enemy. Its first attack on its next Turn deals -2 Damage.
~If it's non-Epic, push it 2 meters away from you. If it collides with something, deal Damage with your current Advanced Flank (load up) die.~
You can only use this once on every Worthy Enemy.
<Recoiling Uncharge>.Notes: Dealing Damage with this ^Downgrades^ the Advanced Flank die.

<Harpoon Load Up>.Effect:
You _load up_ your weapons. After you _load up_, your Advanced Flank die becomes 1d12 instead of 1d6, but every time you use it, the Advanced Flank die becomes ^Downgraded^ (down to 1d4).
~If you roll maximum on the Advanced Flank die, deal an extra 1d6 Damage and either pull yourself to the target, or pull the target to you (your choice).~
If the attack kills the target, don't Downgrade.
<Harpoon Load Up>.Notes: {DiceDowngrade}. Requires a Harpoon, which can be bought for 50 Gold.

<Precise Rune>.Effect:
Craft a Precise Rune.
Inscribe on a weapon to permanently replace one Stat in its text (e.g. Might) with number 4.
The wielder of the weapon is also immune to being Crippled and has +1 Movement Speed.
<Precise Rune>.Notes: You can only have one weapon with the Precise Rune at a time. When you apply a Precise Rune to a different, the other one loses its Precise Rune.

<Ground Aim Lock>.Effect:
On your turn, you can freely lower yourself on the ground without penalties.
Your first attack every turn while on the ground like this deals +1d6 Damage.
<Ground Aim Lock>.Notes: To get up, you must use all a Half-Action.

<Scatterblast>.Effect:
Make an attack on a target for 5d6 Smash Damage.
The impact is so powerful that all Units within 3 meters of the target take the final Damage taken by the target.
This attack is affected by your Reload state.

<Crosshair Shot>.Effect:
Make an attack on a target.
For each meter to the target, the attack deals 1d6 Pierce Damage, up to 7 meters.
For each meter to the target over 7 meters, deal one less d6.
<Crosshair Shot>.Notes: At exactly 7 meters range, the attack deals 7d6 Damage. At 6 and 8 meters, it deals 6d6. At 5 and 9 meters, 5d6. And so on.

<Eagle Eye>.Effect:
While concentrating, you can zoom in on your vision x10 times.
You gain +3 Skill Points you can spend for Skills related to sight, ignoring the normal limit.
<Eagle Eye>.EffectRed: Once you get this Talent, you can no longer change it.

<Manufacturing>.Effect:
You can craft any standard weapon, good or adventuring gear by spending the {Gold}Gold amount.
For 150 {Gold}Gold, you can also craft a parachute, glider, raft, pulley lift, barricade or scuba kit (1 hour duration).
<Manufacturing>.Notes: Like most items, you can sell these to a vendor for 30 {Gold} after being used (20% of the original price).

<Surprise Shot>.Effect: Your first weapon attack every combat instantly Stuns the target.

<Offense Is Defense>.Effect: Whenever you roll maximum on the Advanced Flank die, gain Shielding equal to the roll.

<Crescendo Technique>.Effect:
When NOT flanking a Unit, whenever you make a weapon attack, make another identical attack on the same target for free that does the same Damage (but does not apply effects like Smite and weapon effects).
When you flank a Unit, it becomes Feared.
Also, passively, gain +2 Dexterity and you automatically pass Very Hard Dexterity Checks (requiring at least 20).

<Precision Perfection>.Effect: Use after rolling Damage for an attack. You can ignore all the dice rolled and just take maximum Damage for all of them.
<Precision Perfection>.Notes: Weapon effects might not trigger, since the roll was ignored.

<Make Every Shot Count>.Effect: Every time you make a weapon attack, roll 1d4 to determine an additional effect for it.

Values: Reset your Load Up to d12
Damages all Units in a 5-meter line behind the target for 100% of the Damage
Stun the target and push it 6 meters away from you

<Make Every Shot Count>.Notes: The Load Up die resets before applying it if it was applied.
